h1: Grindelwald ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Grindelwald sits at 1,047 metres directly under the north face of the Eiger, and the Jungfrau Ski Region around it covers two valleys and three mountain ranges: three ski areas holding 211 kilometres of pistes, plus 50 kilometres of sledding trails and 100 kilometres of winter hiking. Above the village, First carries the Snowpark Grindelwald-First and a 45-metre cliff footbridge at 2,166 metres.
stayOverview: The village runs along one road under the Eiger, with the First gondola at one end and the Grindelwald Terminal for the Eiger Express at the other. Wengen and Mürren sit across the valley on the same ski pass.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Grindelwald puts the Eiger outside the window; Wengen and Mürren are car-free and reached by train.
rentalCars: Grindelwald is reached by the Bernese Oberland Railway from Interlaken, about three hours from Zurich.

highlights.title: Under the Eiger

highlights.title: First Flyer
highlights.text: Four people race a steel cable from First to Schreckfeld at up to 84 km/h, in winter too.

lifts.unannounced: The operator counts ski areas and piste kilometres but publishes no lift count for the region.

verticalDrop.unannounced: No vertical drop is published for the ski region.

topElevation.unannounced: The operator names First at 2,166 m, but that is a station on one of the three ski areas, not a stated top for the region.

season.note: The Jungfrau Ski Region ski pass season. The Mürren-Schilthorn area on the same pass runs to 2 May 2027.

snowpark.note: Included in the ski pass; the operator calls it a snowboard and freeski paradise.

baseElevation.unannounced: The region publishes 211 km of pistes across three ski areas and the start and end altitudes of individual descents - the Big Pintenfritz toboggan run drops from 2,552 m to 1,153 m - but states no base altitude for the ski area.

longestRun.unannounced: The region names its longest toboggan run - the 15 km Big Pintenfritz from the Faulhorn - but does not say which piste is its longest.

dayPass.note: The region's own 2026/27 price for a Jungfrau Ski Region ski pass. Up to three children aged 6 to 15 ski free on Saturdays with a full-price adult day or afternoon pass.
